description: Re-check that a file's bytes still match Verified Reality's registry for a prior sealed reference (a media file inside a Truth Packet, a whole Truth Packet zip, or a certified audit PDF). No API key required. A match confirms the file's bytes only — not that the depicted scene was honest, complete, or admissible.

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the file, optionally prefixed with `sha256:`.

kind.description: What kind of file this hash belongs to: a single media file (`media`), a whole Truth Packet zip (`truth_packet_zip`), or a certified audit PDF export (`audit_pdf`).

truth_packet_id.description: Optional: only used with kind=truth_packet_zip, to also assert which packet this should be.

name: verify_media_hash
title: Verify a sealed file's hash
